# Jorge Muñoz Castillo - Portfolio

> Full Stack Web & Mobile Developer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel, and Native Android (Kotlin).

## Overview
Jorge Muñoz Castillo is a software developer focused on building modern web and mobile applications from concept to production. Experienced in REST API architecture, AI integrations, and mobile engineering.

## Featured Projects
- **LinkSight** (https://linksightapp.com): Native Android mobile application for point-to-point RF microwave link planning and Fresnel zone clearance calculations using SRTM90m global topography. Available on Google Play Store.
- **Script2me** (https://script2.me): Web platform that accelerates web and mobile development using Google Gemini AI, featuring real-time code refactoring and security scanner.
- **EmpleaWorks** (https://emplea.works): Regional job board platform and companion native mobile app for candidates and employers in Murcia, Spain.
- **SkillPilot** (https://skillpilot.es): Automated job search and AI application assistant developed with Laravel, React, Docker, and Llama 3.3.

## Skills & Technologies
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vue.js, JavaScript
- **Backend**: Laravel, PHP, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, WordPress, Moodle
- **Mobile**: Android Native (Kotlin), React Native, Expo, RevenueCat, Google Play Billing, EAS CI/CD
- **DevOps & Tools**: Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Git, MySQL, MongoDB, Linux VPS, Bash Scripting
